Note: Xicochi (Mexico, c. 1601): Gaspar Fernandez (d. c. 1629), public domain. The melody is our own setting (KairoPhos, CC0), not a transcription: the surviving cancionero facsimile is not legible enough to read. The villancico's text and identity are the composer's. Melody only; no lyrics.
